hook_en: When your foot slips, His love holds you. 🙏
reflect_en: The psalmist admits it plainly: My foot is slipping, and anxiety overwhelms me. Yet he found that God's loving devotion held him up and His consolation brought joy back to his soul. This Thanksgiving, whatever is weighing on your mind, you can thank Him for being the One who has held you every time you were about to fall.
q_en: What's weighing on your mind today?
x_en: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
tiktok: For the day your foot is slipping 🙏 Psalm 94:18–19 — Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me
yt_line: Let Him hold you up today.
li_open: Even steady leaders have days when their footing slips.
li_quote: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
li_body: The psalmist didn't hide his anxiety; he named it, and found that God's loving devotion held him up. Leaders who are honest about their own need for prayer make it safe for their people to ask for prayer too, and that kind of care is something worth giving thanks for.
hook_es: Cuando tu pie resbala, Su misericordia te sostiene. 🙏
reflect_es: El salmista lo dice con sinceridad: Mi pie resbala. Pero descubrió que la misericordia de Dios lo sustentaba y que, en medio de la multitud de sus pensamientos, Sus consolaciones alegraban su alma. Sea lo que sea que llene tu mente este jueves, puedes darle gracias porque Él te ha sostenido cada vez que estabas a punto de caer.
x_es: Cuando yo decía: Mi pie resbala: tu misericordia, oh Jehová, me sustentaba.
